verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's structure, hierarchy and left-to-right reading order intact, but it is basically the original dropped into a taller canvas: the content sits in a small middle band with dead space above and below, and the text is no bigger, so it under-uses the format. B actually rearranges the layout, but the logo is blown up to rival the headline and the reading order is broken: headline bottom-left, suitcase in the middle, then body copy and CTA jammed top-right. The CTA and sunglasses pile onto the circle, the sunglasses crowd the right edge, and the composition feels cramped and has no clear focal point.
